_comment: Scoring V3 calibration constants. Derived from confirmed cycle dates — regenerate with tools/calibrate_v3.py if dates change.

coherence_dampening._comment: neutral_target = expected score when OC metrics fully agree at this phase. coh_floor = minimum coh_factor applied even when OC metrics disagree.

tiz._comment: Weight of TiZ in the final blend, scaled by w_bot. Full weight only at w_bot=1.0.

dxy_modifier._comment: DXY macro modifier. IC(dxy_norm, fwd_ret_365)=+0.28 from backtest_dxy.py. High DXY = BTC bottom = REDUCE risk score.
